threshold_note: calibrated=false -> Jev CHI XEP HANG (thu tu uu tien xu ly), KHONG nang muc do phan cap. Muc P1-P4 chi lay tu ../_shared/severity-and-escalation.md va bang nguong cua skill tai references/thresholds.md. Diem so cua Jev khong duoc dung de quyet dinh muc P1-P4.
scope: Xep hang canh bao DLP de sap xep thu tu xu ly. Khong phat hien moi su co, khong thay the phan cap P1-P4, khong tu chay hanh dong khoa/xoa.

thresholds._reason: Chua co bang hieu chinh tren bo du lieu canh bao DLP cua ngan hang (khong co mau co nhan ket luan). De null de tranh tu dat nguong. Khi co bang do, phai ghi mau so, so mau va ket qua vao file nay truoc khi dung.

dlp_true_positive.instructions: Do the alert fields (user, policy, action taken, files, recipients) show a real policy violation by a person, rather than a rule that is misconfigured or a test activity?
criteria: co bang chung nguoi dung + policy + file/tin nhan + hanh dong DLP
khong co bang chung nguoi dung hoac policy khong ton tai

data_sensitivity.instructions: Which data classification best matches the content involved in this alert?

criteria.pii: names, ID numbers, date of birth, addresses
criteria.noi_bo: internal memos, HR or routine documents

route_external.instructions: Where did the data go according to the alert record?

criteria.email_ngoai: sent to an external or personal mailbox
criteria.cloud_ca_nhan: uploaded to a personal or unapproved cloud service

volume_anomaly.instructions: Do the record counts, file sizes and recipient counts in this alert stand out compared with the thresholds for this skill?
criteria: so luong vuot nguong phat hien trong references/thresholds.md
so luong nam duoi nguong hoac khong xac dinh duoc

repeat_pattern.instructions: Does this alert repeat a pattern already seen for the same user, or is it a single isolated event?
criteria: lap lai nhieu lan cho cung nguoi dung
su kien don le, khong co mau trung hop

severity.instructions: How soon should an analyst open this alert? The bank hard rules already set the severity floor; this score only orders the review queue and never raises the severity.
criteria: theo_doi: khong can mo them, theo doi dinh ky
xem_trong_ngay: mo sau cac muc P1/P2 theo hang doi uu tien
xem_ngay: mo song song voi hang doi uu tien
